Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Suresh - 32 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Vinod - 61 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
3. Neeta - 59 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Karan - 31 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Neeta, Vinod and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "What lovely weather!"

[Suresh's car crashes into a pole.]

Karan (happily): "Show me too!"

[A dog runs in front of Suresh's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Suresh: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The village well - Day

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Suresh draws water from the well with the rope.]

Suresh: "Mom, listen!"

[Suresh splashes water on his face at the well.]

Suresh: "That's great!"

[Suresh grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Karan (excited): "That's easy."

[Suresh churns butter in the earthen pot.]

Suresh: "That was such a fun day!"
